support_diagnostic.definition: I2 PA counts available before the active monthly direct-model cutoff; no hindsight season totals
dimensions: mean support of three least-supported lineup batters
support_diagnostic.conclusion: No stable low-support concentration explains the bottom-half residual. Bias persists across support quartiles; 2026 largest pitcher-support miss occurs in highest-support quartile.

park_diagnostic.definition: pregame change in predicted half-inning scoring probability caused by governed Savant park layer versus neutral park
park_diagnostic.absolute_magnitude_conclusion: Absolute park-effect magnitude does not monotonically explain bottom-half bias.
park_diagnostic.interpretation: Bottom-half underprediction is concentrated when the park layer suppresses scoring, but association is not causal proof and a general bottom-half level bias remains plausible.

decision: Do not alter player-support shrinkage and do not directly retune park factors yet.

next_phase.name: Phase 29C bottom residual mechanism test
next_phase.objective: Distinguish global bottom-half level bias from excessive bottom-half park suppression using precommitted low-dimensional corrections.
candidates: bottom logit offset plus park-effect attenuation
next_phase.park_effect_parameterization: logit(bottom scoring probability with governed park) minus logit(bottom scoring probability with neutral park)
next_phase.governance: Fit/select using 2022-2024 only; freeze candidate and coefficients before 2025 validation; 2026 replication only. Full-year samples, no month controls, no market data. Any candidate must improve full-I2 Under 0.5 log loss and Brier, not merely bottom-half calibration.
